notes: Reflection demonstrator. Buggy ceil-division `items // per_page + 1`. Dropping `+ 1` fixes test_exact_multiple and test_zero_items but regresses test_one_over and test_one_under; re-adding `+ 1` flips it back. Two mutually-exclusive forms of one expression (`x//y` vs `x//y+1`); raw test_output only ever shows one side, so a temp=0 retry oscillates. The correct fix is the third form `(items + per_page - 1) // per_page`, which no single failing test's output suggests. Reflection naming the trade-off redirects to the joint fix.
